description: One span of a trace: a named, timed unit of work with an optional parent, an outcome and an optional bag of numeric metrics (tokens in/out, cost, …). Data only — the model carries no callbacks and no rendering hints, so a backend can build the exact objects the waterfall renders. A host supplies a FLAT list; the tree comes from ParentId: a blank ParentId is a root, a ParentId naming no supplied span is an ORPHAN attached under the root (never silently dropped), and a parent cycle is REJECTED — reported by the layout instead of throwing or recursing forever. Span ids must be unique; an empty id, and every span repeating an already-seen id, is ignored (the first occurrence wins).

members.name: Id
members.description: The stable identity of the span within one trace, used for the parent links, the selection (@bind-SelectedSpanId) and the row keys. Required and unique; an empty id is ignored rather than rendered.

members.name: ParentId
members.description: The Id of the parent span, or null for a root. A value that names no supplied span makes the span an orphan (rendered under the root); a value that closes a cycle rejects the cycle instead of hanging the layout.

members.name: Name
members.description: The human name of the span ("gpt-4o completion", "search_web", …). A blank name falls back to Id, so a row is never nameless.

members.name: Kind
members.description: What the span represents. Drives the row's icon, its --tm-trace-* colour and its visually hidden kind name. Default Custom.

members.name: StartedAt
members.description: The absolute start of the span on the trace clock. The axis starts at the earliest start of the whole trace.

members.name: EndedAt
members.description: The absolute end of the span. Null means "not finished yet": the layout extends the bar to the caller-supplied "now", which is what makes a Running span grow in live mode. A value earlier than StartedAt is treated as a zero-length span, never as a negative bar.

members.name: Status
members.description: The outcome of the span. Running is the only value that keeps the live ticker redrawing; Error renders an icon AND localized text, so the state never rides on colour alone. Default Ok.

members.name: Metrics
members.description: Numeric metrics of the span, keyed ordinally (tokens_in, tokens_out, cost, …). MetricColumns decides which keys are visible; the layout sums every key over each subtree, so a parent shows both its own value and its subtree total. Default: an empty, shared map wrapped in ReadOnlyDictionary, so a caller that casts it back to a dictionary gets a NotSupportedException instead of changing the default of every span.

members.name: Attributes
members.description: Free-form string attributes of the span (model name, tool version, HTTP status, …). The waterfall does not interpret them — they are for the host's DetailTemplate and for tooling that serialises the trace. Default: an empty, shared map wrapped in ReadOnlyDictionary, so a caller that casts it back to a dictionary gets a NotSupportedException instead of changing the default of every span.
